Maya Patel: FYI — quick afternoon coverage note. Between ~12:45 and 13:30 PT we saw a spike in 503s from embeddings service for a subset of customers (traffic concentrated on eu-west). Short summary and handoff below.
incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-service | 503 error rate > 5% | 12:46 UTC | Pager suppressed (investigating)
Jerome Klein: I was primary during the window. Symptoms: p95 token latency climbed from 180ms -> 650ms, then 503s when request queue hit GPU pool limits. Saw high queue depth on pool-3.
Olivia Chen: I covered secondary. Confirmed that model-variant routing tried fallback to quantized v1 but that path had insufficient burst capacity in eu-west.
Samir Rao: Observability notes — CPU on control-plane spikes correlated with scaling events, and redis eviction rate ticked up. Relevant dashboards: embeddings->latency, request-queue, model-pool-util.
Jerome Klein: Mitigations we applied in order:
- bumped pool-3 replicas from 4 -> 8 using the autoscale override
- temporarily disabled per-tenant soft quotas for heavy-embed tenants in eu-west
- turned on routing fallback to smaller-batch path (lower throughput but stable)
oncall-helper-bot: Command run:
```
# emergency scale override
rwictl pool update --name pool-3 --replicas 8 --reason "afternoon spike eu-west"
# enable small-batch routing
rwictl routing set --policy embeddings --fallback small-batch-quantized-v1
```
Olivia Chen: After scale, error rate dropped to ~0.8% and latency went back to p95 ~220ms. Customer impact: some requests retried by SDK; we saw a handful of customer-facing 5xxs for ~18 minutes total. Logged customers: cust-psi, cust-lumen (sre tickets created).
Maya Patel: Coverage/roles for next shift: primary = Jerome Klein (continuing for 30m), secondary = Olivia Chen (cover until 18:00 PT). After that, night primary is Samir Rao per rotation — Samir please confirm handover.
Samir Rao: I will take primary at 18:00 PT. Action items for me to pick up:
- validate pool autoscaler config to avoid manual overrides in eu-west
- follow up on redis eviction cause and soft-quota behavior
- check canary telemetry for small-batch fallback correctness
Jerome Klein: Open todo items I left in the incident thread:
- revert soft-quota disable if autoscale stable (jerome: follow up in 1h)
- add temporary alert for queue depth > 250
Olivia Chen: Runbook pointers:
- Embeddings degradations runbook: https://internal.redwood/confluence/embeddings-runbook
- Autoscaler config doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/autoscaler
- Quick fix checklist (in repo): `./ops/embeddings/emergency_playbook.md`
Maya Patel: Known coverage gap: APAC region had no additional on-call overlap this afternoon; our fallback couldn't burst there. Samir, please add a postmortem action to evaluate cross-region burst reserves.
Samir Rao: Will do. Also will schedule a short postmortem doc with timeline + action owners by EOD tomorrow.
Maya Patel: Anything else? If not, tagging :white_check_mark: and handing off monitoring to Samir at 18:00 PT.
Jerome Klein: ack. leaving logs & snippets in the incident doc.
oncall-helper-bot: Incident summary note saved: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2026-03-15-embeddings-eu-west-brief
incident-bot: [INFO] No active pages. Continued monitoring for 2h recommended.
Maya Patel: thanks team — closing thread for now, please escalate if new regressions show up.
